```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(

  comment = "#>"

```

The default behavior of basecoat is to act as a pure html library. However, you can **opt-in** to [`{shiny}`](TODO!) interactivity.

Note that, if you are using basecoat with the shiny package, you should always use the basecoat components _instead_ of shiny or an alternative library like `{bslib}` (TODO hyperlink).

This is because both shiny and bslib use the bootstrap library for styling. basecoat is based on tailwind css (TODO hyperlink).
